inference.batch_order: degree then frozen design order then source net order

statistics.confidence_intervals: final cross-experiment inference belongs to Stage8; Stage7 reports all seeds and paired net differences
statistics.degree_aggregation: pool all degree nets before computing each seed metric
statistics.design_macro: equal mean over the 20 design means
statistics.missing: retain all 100 design-degree rows; missing is not invalid
statistics.p95: numpy linear quantile across all nets, computed separately for each seed
statistics.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of the three independently computed seed metrics
statistics.worst_design: maximum design mean per seed; report mean of three seed maxima
